source.name: Battle Fury
source.description:
+50 damage.
Melee attacks deal 50% cleave damage in a range of 1 square.
source.lore: The Drodo Island Committee has banned private tree-cutting activities here, with permission granted to a small batch of contractors. This decent replica of the legendary tool is offered for entertainment purposes only.
